_comment: EXT-63, arm 24 — 12 h REFERENCE: the canonical single-layer EXT-CB posture with NO
LV cards (deg-8 single layer + a00 GIM anchor 32.24+-2 + rx_code_bias_datum).  The
matched control for arm 25.  Same lineage, same window, one difference: the four LV
WHY 12 h.  1 h settles the LEVEL but not the slow channels: the standing rule is
that total_IF and any drift claim need >= 2 h, and the breathing measured on this
lineage runs on a 20-30 min cycle, so an hour holds only two periods.  12 h also
exposes what an hour cannot: whether the level PARKS or slowly walks, and whether
the deg-1 dipole (which grew with the level fix at 1 h) keeps growing.
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN: reproduces the 1 h shape and then keeps
breathing -- a00 well below GIM 32.24 (1 h settled mean 17.45), oscillating on the
constellation-sweep timescale, gate 0/0/0, in-band throughout.  This arm exists to
be the honest denominator, not to be interesting.
